kind: Captioned technical walkthrough of real domain outputs
audio: none; captions are visible in every scene

scenes.title: Know what is next. Keep the proof.
scenes.caption: One notice. Source-linked actions. Dates that need a deliberate check.
content: A narrow tool for students reviewing school, club and administrative notices.

This video presents real rule-engine outputs and export checks.
It is not a recording of the browser interface.

scenes.title: Start with the original notice.
scenes.caption: An invented practice notice supplies the input for every result shown here.
content:
CAMPUS FIELD TRIP
Synthetic practice notice, not an actual event.

Register for the architecture trip by Nov. 5, 2032.
Pay the bus deposit by Nov. 8, 2032 at 17:00 UTC-10:00.
Participants must attach a signed consent form.

If you need accessible transport, email the coordinator by next Friday.
You do not need to pay a separate membership fee.

scenes.title: Three proposals. No automatic approval.
scenes.caption: The local English text rules run on the source, with no model or API request.
content:
1. Register for the architecture trip
    Proposed date: 2032-11-05
2. Pay the bus deposit
    Proposed date: 2032-11-08
3. email the coordinator by next Friday
    Proposed date: unresolved
2 passages flagged. Initial downloads: 0 checklist tasks, 0 calendar entries.

scenes.title: Different tasks, different deadlines.
scenes.caption: Exact quotations establish where words occurred, not whether the interpretation is right.
content: Register for the architecture trip by Nov. 5, 2032.
Pay the bus deposit by Nov. 8, 2032 at 17:00 UTC-10:00.

scenes.title: Repair an instruction the rules missed.
scenes.caption: The real repair function creates a separate action from the exact flagged passage.
content: Participants must attach a signed consent form.

New action: Attach a signed consent form
Date: unresolved. Approval: unchecked.

scenes.title: A waived fee stays out of the tasks.
scenes.caption: The scripted source decision records its reason and preserves the original flag.
content: You do not need to pay a separate membership fee.

Decision: not an obligation.
No separate membership-fee task or event is created.

scenes.title: Keep the condition. Keep the uncertainty.
scenes.caption: The program does not turn next Friday into a guessed calendar date.
content: If you need accessible transport, email the coordinator by next Friday.

Condition: If you need accessible transport
Date: unresolved. Calendar: excluded.

scenes.title: Approval and date confirmation are separate.
scenes.caption: These are scripted contract checks, not a claim that a person reviewed the notice.
content:
Fresh scan: 0 checklist tasks, 0 calendar entries.
After action checks: 4 checklist tasks, 0 calendar entries.
After complete date checks: 4 checklist tasks, 2 calendar entries.
The undated consent form and conditional email remain checklist-only.

scenes.title: The checklist keeps its evidence.
scenes.caption: This is an excerpt from the actual Markdown serializer output.
content:
Notice: AUTOMATED TECHNICAL WALKTHROUGH: Invented architecture trip

- [ ] Register for the architecture trip
  - Reviewed date: 2032-11-05 (day marker)
  - Action source: “Register for the architecture trip by Nov. 5, 2032.”
- [ ] Pay the bus deposit
  - Reviewed date: 2032-11-08 17:00 UTC-10:00
  - Action source: “Pay the bus deposit by Nov. 8, 2032 at 17:00 UTC-10:00.”

scenes.title: Only two dates enter the calendar.
scenes.caption: The timed cutoff is converted to the same instant in UTC, with no inferred reminder.
content:
BEGIN:VEVENT
DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20321105
DTEND;VALUE=DATE:20321106
SUMMARY:Register for the architecture trip
END:VEVENT
BEGIN:VEVENT
DTSTART:20321109T030000Z
SUMMARY:Pay the bus deposit
END:VEVENT
Selected properties shown. Complete files also retain quotations, warnings and context.

scenes.title: Changed data needs fresh review.
scenes.caption: The capture also exercised edit invalidation and the real saved-review parser.
content:
Edit a reviewed cutoff:
Action approval cleared. Date confirmation cleared.

Reopen a saved review:
0 checklist tasks and 0 calendar entries until checked again.

scenes.title: Built with AI. Runs without an AI bill.
scenes.caption: Codex used the Devpost Learn Skill Pack; generated planning documents are public.
content:
Runtime: local English text rules, React and TypeScript.
One self-contained browser file. No account, model download or API credits.
Automated checks are not student feedback or proof of complete language understanding.
